title: Intake: interactive-path skipped definition fields become null and render a stray '- null' bullet in PROJECT.md
description:
Pre-existing bug found by the TASK-166 developer (2026-07-18), confirmed benign-to-TASK-166 by the reviewer but real on its own path. Repro (interactive wizard only): when an optional definition field (goals/scope_in/scope_out) is skipped via runQuestionnaire (empty/Enter answer), src/question-engine.js validateAndCoerce sets the value to null (not ''/absent). bin/init.js normalizeDefinitionAnswers explicitly skips normalizing null values (`if (v === null || v === undefined) continue;`), so the field stays null. src/project-md.js's bullet renderer (`const items = Array.isArray(value) ? value : [value];`) treats non-array null as a single-item [null] array and emits a stray `## Goals
- null` heading+bullet in PROJECT.md. Answers-mode already correctly omits the heading for ''/[] (TASK-046 AC6a locks that), so this reproduces only via the interactive path.

FIX DIRECTION (either, developer's judgment): (a) normalizeDefinitionAnswers treats null the same as ''/[] (normalize to []), or (b) project-md.js's bullet-section guard treats a non-array null/undefined value as empty before the items.length===0 check. Prefer whichever is the smaller, more root-cause fix; add a regression lock reproducing the interactive-skip -> PROJECT.md render path.
acceptance_criteria: An interactive wizard run where goals/scope_in/scope_out are skipped (Enter) produces a PROJECT.md with NO '- null' bullet and NO empty definition heading for the skipped fields (matching answers-mode's existing correct behavior).
A regression lock reproduces the pre-fix bug path (null field surviving into the renderer) and proves the fix (red-green planted).
Existing TASK-046 AC6a empty-omission specs and all wizard/project-md specs stay green.
dist/init.cjs (and any other bundle embedding the touched source) rebuilt + committed if bundled source changed; dist-parity green.
